findings.message: No test checks the room's results feed for two of the nine accomplishment columns: duels drawn and caches claimed. MatchRoom.ts reports a cache claim from its ledger diff (the `before.kind === "cache"` branch that reports `cache-claimed`, around line 1056) and a draw as a `duel-ended` report with `winner: null` (around line 1380), but no test ever reaches either path and then reads the results. All four endings in tests/integration/endings.test.ts expect duelsDrawn: 0 and cachesClaimed: 0 for every line, and so does the full-match browser check. The draw test in seaDuelHarness.test.ts and the recovery-cache test in rubbings.test.ts never end the match or look at the results. flowHud.test.ts only renders a hand-written cachesClaimed: 1, and packages/simulation/src/match tests only cover the pure module. The room could drop both reports, or misreport them, and every check would still pass. Needed: an integration ending, through the real room, with a settled draw and a cache claim, asserting the exact duelsDrawn and cachesClaimed numbers.
findings.requirement: The room feeds these from ledger and encounter events.

findings.message: The carry-forward fix `if (event.repeat) return;` in the theft-choice keydown handler (apps/web/src/main.ts, around line 2380 of the diff) has no test. No unit test, and no browser step in theftLoop.spec.ts, sends a keydown with repeat=true (or holds 1/2 down during a choice window) and asserts that only one choose-theft goes out or that the choice doesn't change. The guard could be removed and every check would still pass.
findings.requirement: ignore key auto-repeat (`event.repeat`) in the theft-choice key handler

findings.message: Only some claim-reset reasons are checked in the UI, and one never happens in a test at all. The integration tests put `moved`, `released`, `duel` and `disconnected` into the holder's status. The `ineligible` (lost type) reset of a running channel never happens in any test: in claim.test.ts the channel resets for `duel`, and the later type loss is only shown to block a new channel. On the UI side, flowHud.test.ts asserts the reason text for `moved` and `duel` only. The text shown for `disconnected`, `ineligible` (a lost type) and `released` is not asserted anywhere, unit or browser. So 'with the reason shown' is unchecked for a disconnect and a lost type.
findings.requirement: Moving, a lost type, a disconnect or a duel reservation resets it, with the reason shown.
